reader_summary.headline: Matt Breitfelder is a Partner and Global Head of Human Capital at Apollo Global Management.
reader_summary.overview: Matt Breitfelder is a Partner and Global Head of Human Capital at Apollo Global Management. Matt previously served as Chief Talent Officer and member of the Operating Committee at BlackRock and is the co-author of numerous Harvard Business School case studies on leadership.. Our conversation covers Matt's upbring at the intersection of business and psychology, lessons from high stakes negotiations working for the US Department of Commerce.
